course_review/1.card_source: AllSquare Golf (allsquaregolf.com/golf-courses/missouri/adams-pointe-golf-club), fetched 2026-10-30; the page shows metres, converted to yards (x1.0936). course_review/1.summary: Card found (AllSquare, Gold 6,938 yds par 72). The page's osm_back set is the Gold tees: all 18 pars match and 16 of 18 holes are within 7 yds of the Gold card; hole 1 differs by the dogleg measurement and hole 2 plays 53 yds longer than the card from the back of the only back box. All 18 CHECKs were 'no card'. Safe to publish; better after a rebuild with the card typed in (set name Gold instead of osm_back).
